fusions.name: Seize and Slam
fusions.desc: Seizes the target in your talons and slams it down for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: From a Great Height
fusions.desc: Drops a boulder on the first enemy in its path for 30 damage. Every other enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 80% of that.

fusions.name: Strutting Display
fusions.desc: A threat display that pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Swing Into It
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
